subject: Question about your event support package
text: Hello, I represent a community club interested in your planning services. Could you send details on hourly fees, booking lead time, and what is included for a small evening gathering? Since our budget is limited, would it be possible to use a shorter initial consultation followed by a written checklist instead of full-day coverage? That alternative might suit our schedule. We are hoping to learn more before deciding. Thank you for your help.
